latestVersion.changelog:
auto-content-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Automated Content Generation Pipeline Skill
- Scrapes viral content from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit using Apify
- Uses AI (Claude/OpenClaw) to extract viral hooks, generate scripts, captions, carousels, and threads
- Automatically creates a weekly content calendar and schedules posts across multiple platforms
- Operates autonomously once configured, requiring minimal human input
- Tracks content performance and feeds insights back into the pipeline for continuous improvement
